title: Shadowstep answers only your Units that die
notes: R4395000: Shadowstep's base face answers only Units of yours that die, not a destroyed Field Spell, Trap or Field Trap; its v0.6.9e script is kept for replays (R767000).

player.title: Shadowstep answers only your Units
fixes: Shadowstep also sprang when a Field Spell or Trap of yours was destroyed, and handed it back at cost 0 although no Unit of yours had died.
It now waits for a Unit of yours to die and brings back only Units; a Field Spell or Trap destroyed beside them stays in your graveyard.
